_note: Acoustic EVIDENCE, never a verdict. A04 reports what the waveform shows. Whether a transient at 5:32 breaches a clause is A11's decision, made with the clause text and an advocate.
_purpose: Impulsive events. THE honest boundary in this agent: DSP resolves that a transient occurred and characterises it — attack time, crest factor, bandwidth, decay. It does NOT resolve what made it. A gunshot, a door slam, a dropped microphone and a balloon pop are acoustically similar at this level of analysis.

labels.label: impulsive_transient
labels.evidence: sub-20ms attack, crest factor above 8, broadband

labels.label: sustained_transient
labels.evidence: fast attack with a long decay

labels.label: gunshot
